app_info.subtitle: Search governed JM routes
app_info.description: JM3232 Navigator helps users search the JM Estate, fetch preserved source records, resolve RootWords, inspect source lineage, and check the live publication boundary. This public Plugin descendant is deliberately read-only and preserves source identity and claim boundaries without exposing shared mutable user state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Search only ranks and returns matching preserved Estate and Radius records without changing Navigator state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search reads Navigator-mounted records and does not modify public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Search does not delete, overwrite, revoke, publish, or otherwise irreversibly change stored records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetch retrieves one preserved source record by stable ID and does not change Navigator state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetch returns data already mounted in Navigator and does not write to external systems or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Fetch cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, publish, or irreversibly alter any record.

justifications.read_only_justification: RootWord resolution reads Radius Lexicon records and returns governed meanings, boundaries, and related entries without changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool operates on Navigator-mounted lexical records and does not change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool cannot delete, overwrite, publish, revoke, or irreversibly alter records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lineage lookup only returns preserved source, authority, relationships, and claim-boundary information.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool reads Navigator data and does not write to public internet state or a third-party service.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool performs no deletion, overwrite, revocation, publication, or irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Bridge status only reads mounted source counts and the live publication boundary.
justifications.open_world_justification: The status check does not change public internet state or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The status check performs no deletion, overwrite, revocation, publication, or irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Search the governed Estate for a known conceptual body.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search the JM Estate for Radius Lexicon and show me the strongest matching records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ranked matching records with stable IDs and source information without merging distinct source bodies.

test_cases.description: Fetch a known preserved source record after a stable ID is available.
test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch the full Navigator record with ID RL-RADIUS-LEXICON.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the preserved record, metadata, relationships, flags, and source route for the requested stable ID.

test_cases.description: Resolve a JM RootWord through the Radius Lexicon.
test_cases.user_prompt: Resolve the RootWord 'Radius' and show its meaning radius, use law, visual face, and claim boundary.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the strongest Radius Lexicon entry with governed meaning, boundaries, visual and wordplay faces, and nearby alternatives.

test_cases.description: Inspect the preserved lineage for a known Estate or Radius record.
test_cases.user_prompt: Return the source lineage for RL-RADIUS-LEXICON and show its authority and claim boundary.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns preserved source, authority, lineage, connections, and the claim boundary for the requested record.

test_cases.description: Check the live public Navigator publication boundary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the current JM3232 Navigator bridge status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the mounted source counts and confirms the public read-only publication boundary without changing state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Navigator for unrelated weather information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in London tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Navigator should not be invoked because current weather is outside its Estate retrieval, RootWord, lineage, and status workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Navigator merely to draft unrelated prose.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write me a funny birthday message for my friend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Navigator should not be invoked because the request does not require Estate retrieval or governed JM source routing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose owner-only write functions through the public Plugin.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Stringmark and export a SavePack for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The public Plugin should not invoke owner-only write tools; it is deliberately read-only and does not expose Stringmark, registration, receipt, or SavePack mutations.
